item.title: IIT-Bombay suicide case: Victim's father threatens hunger strike
item.description: In a gripping turn of events, Sahil Wakode's father declared his intention to go on a hunger strike if the authorities do not act concerning his son's death. In response, IIT-B has put together an investigative committee, headed by Prof Ramesh Venkateswaran. The university community is in turmoil, with students demanding answers while simultaneously standing by the professor linked to the case, highlighting big worries regarding campus security protocols.

item.title: Apple is building a screenless Whoop rival, but it may not launch before 2028
item.description: Apple is developing a screenless fitness tracker to rival Whoop, according to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman. Prototypes pair a thin fabric band with a sensor-packed computing module. Backed by Tim Cook and Eddy Cue, the project is in an early stage, and Apple hasn't decided whether to launch it. If it does, the band is unlikely to arrive before 2028, as Whoop and Oura keep growing.

item.title: ‘I can start my senior career confidently’: Anahat Singh on what comes next
item.description: Anahat Singh has finished with the juniors, winning the World Junior Championship in her final year. Now comes the Asian Games, where she is the third seed in the women's singles draw and the gold carries a quota place for LA 2028. After a senior breakthrough in Hong Kong, she is working on her physicality, learning from Gregory Gaultier and Saurav Ghosal, and taking it one event at a time.
item.dc:creator: VINEET RAMAKRISHNAN

item.title: Heavy LHB bogie corrosion worries Railways; toilet leaks, saline air blamed
item.description: Recently senior railway engineers have raised concerns over heavy corrosion in the bogies of LHB passenger coaches, despite the use of materials that are designed to resist corrosion and efforts to strengthen cleaning and maintenance practices.
item.dc:creator: TOI BUSINESS DESK

item.title: Oil prices ease as Saudi restores key pipeline, traders optimistic on US-Iran talks
item.description: Oil prices have dropped below $100 a barrel due to Saudi Arabia restarting crude supply operations. Diplomatic efforts to resolve the US-Iran conflict have also contributed to easing market pressure. US crude inventories increased by 1.8 million barrels in the past week, contrary to analysts' expectations. Iraq is reportedly increasing its oil exports, signaling a shift in regional supply dynamics.
item.dc:creator: SHIVANGHI PAYAL

item.title: Leicestershire estate that hosted Michael Jackson listed for £18M
item.description: Historic Leicestershire estate Stapleford Park, which has hosted celebrities including Michael Jackson, Lionel Richie, David Beckham and Will Smith, has gone on the market for £18 million. The Grade I-listed property, where Peter Crouch and Abbey Clancy married in 2011, spans 54 acres and features 48 bedrooms, a spa, tennis courts and an indoor pool.

item.title: USCIS warns against websites and businesses ‘guaranteeing’ faster visa
item.description: USCIS has issued a warning to visa applicants regarding fraudulent businesses that claim to expedite processing times through alleged government ties for a fee. It is crucial for applicants to utilize official .gov resources and report any suspicious offers they encounter. The Department of Justice also provides lists of affordable legal immigration services, alongside tips from USCIS on correctly filling out both online and mailed application forms.

item.title: Uttarakhand school's anti-mobile 'lesson' under scanner
item.description: In Khatima, Uttarakhand, a school conducted a startling exercise regarding smartphone use, where a student simulated a grisly scenario claiming eye removal due to excessive screen time. This prompted emotional reactions, with many tears shed among peers. Consequently, the local education department initiated an investigation, advising the school to prioritize student welfare in future programs.

item.description: Savannah James has invested in the LOVB Los Angeles volleyball team. Her daughter Zhuri's passion for the sport inspired this significant personal investment. item.title: How Travis Kelce saved $640K on his $5.35M Ohio mansion purchase
item.description: In a remarkable real estate move, Travis Kelce has acquired an impressive mansion in Ohio for $5.35 million, marking a significant drop from the original asking price. This property had already experienced a price reduction prior to Kelce's involvement, with his team successfully negotiating the final cost down by $640,000. This purchase signifies Kelce's strong ties to his hometown.

item.title: Why kids talk to toys and imaginary friends: When parents should worry
item.description: Many kids enjoy pretend play with imaginary pals or stuffed toys, fostering their communication skills. Engaging in this type of play is typical and does not necessarily indicate loneliness. However, if children display notable changes in behavior regarding their imaginary friends, parents should take note. Asking about these imaginary companions can initiate valuable conversations and strengthen the parent-child bond, prioritizing the child's happiness above all.

item.title: Presley Gerber's death case linked to Matthew Perry amid suspected Ketamine use
item.description: Presley Gerber's body was released by the Medical Examiner following his tragic death at a rehabilitation facility. He was found unresponsive shortly after being admitted, and authorities suspect an overdose. Reports indicate he had a history of substance use issues, including a prescription for ketamine. Gerber had previously documented his struggles with addiction and mental health publicly.

item.title: Ganesh Utsav turns tragic: Woman dies after falling into boiling sambar in Andhra
item.description: A Ganesh Utsav food donation program, a woman named Sujatha tragically lost her life due to severe burn injuries. While aiding in the cooking process, she accidentally fell into a boiling sambar vessel. Although she was rushed to a hospital for treatment, she unfortunately did not survive. This devastating incident has overshadowed the joyous Ganesh Chaturthi celebrations.
item.dc:creator: VENU LANKA

item.title: India’s space sovereignty: From building missions to building depth
item.description: India has proven its capability to design and launch complex spacecraft independently. The nation now focuses on building industrial depth for space sovereignty and self-reliance. A burgeoning private sector and numerous startups are transforming India's space ecosystem. Future missions aim for a space station and lunar exploration by 2040. Component-level self-reliance remains a critical challenge for sustained space endeavors.
item.dc:creator: TRISHA MAHAJAN

item.title: Turkey, Egypt, Saudi, Pak affirm Riyadh’s right to self-defence amid Houthi attacks
item.description: Foreign ministers from four nations affirmed Saudi Arabia's right to self-defense. They stressed the importance of maintaining safe navigation in the region. Support was voiced for Yemen's government in its peace efforts.

item.title: ‘Must act now’: Kashmiri leader urges UNHRC action over situation in PoJK, PoGB
item.description: Sardar Shaukat Ali Kashmiri has appealed to the UN Human Rights Council for urgent intervention regarding deteriorating human rights conditions in Pakistan-occupied Jammu and Kashmir. He emphasised the need for an independent investigation into alleged violations and arbitrary detentions, while also voicing concerns about the issues surrounding political representation and land rights in Pakistan-occupied Gilgit-Baltistan.
